label: SOS response
definition: A stress response in which RecA/LexA-mediated sensing of DNA damage derepresses an SOS regulon that coordinates DNA repair, damage tolerance, transient division arrest, and mutagenic survival functions.
observations: DNA-damage-inducible branch of the stress-response hierarchy; distinct from broader DNA damage response terms and narrower RecA, LexA, SulA, DNA-repair, translesion-synthesis, mutagenesis, and prophage-induction terms.
